page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.g5ne.8xlarge is a general-purpose instance powered by the KVM hypervisor. It features 32 dedicated physical cores on an Intel Xeon 8163 processor running at 2.5 GHz with an x86_64 architecture. The instance is configured with 128.0 GB of system memory, providing 4.0 GB of RAM per core. It does not include local storage or GPU accelerators, relying entirely on network-attached storage and a baseline network bandwidth of 15 Gbps.

Benchmark data reveals a clear distinction between single-core and multi-core performance. Single-core metrics, such as the stress-ng single-core CPU performance and Geekbench single-core score, fall into the bottom 25% tier. Similarly, single-threaded tasks like gzip compression and text processing show weak to poor performance. However, the 32 dedicated cores compensate in multi-threaded workloads, achieving average tier results in stress-ng multi-core, Geekbench multi-core, and bzip3 multi-threaded decompression. Memory bandwidth also remains in the average tier, though Passmark memory scores are relatively weak.

Given its hardware profile and performance characteristics, this instance is appropriate for multi-threaded workloads that do not require high single-core clock speeds. Suitable applications include static web serving, software compilation, and database operations, where it achieves average benchmark throughput. It can also handle moderate LLM inference tasks for smaller models. From a cost-efficiency perspective, the instance offers a balanced resource density of vCPUs to memory, making it a viable option for parallelized general-purpose workloads where multi-core scaling offsets lower single-thread efficiency.
